name: B10-0068/2025 (PfE) – Situation in Venezuela following the usurpation of the presidency on 10 January 2025
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Venezuela following the usurpation of the presidency on the 10th of January 2025
part_text:
The European Parliament says Edmundo González Urrutia won Venezuela's July 2024 election and is the country's legitimate president. It calls Nicolás Maduro's swearing-in on 10 January 2025 a coup. It asks the European Union and its member states to recognise González Urrutia as president. It also asks for more sanctions on Maduro's officials, a freeze on Venezuelan state funds in Europe, and the release of all political prisoners. This is the Parliament's opinion; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament asks the EU to recognise González Urrutia as Venezuela's president; EU governments decide.
- It wants more sanctions and frozen Venezuelan funds; this affects Maduro's officials and the Venezuelan state.
- It demands the release of political prisoners; the Venezuelan government would have to act.
